internal.title: Incident Resolved: Elevated Error Rate in Cart Service Due to Error Injection Flag
internal.body: At 12:30 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate (~10-12%) and elevated latency (~1.2s) in the cart service. Logs indicated Valkey connection errors. The root cause was identified as an error injection triggered by the 'cartFailure' flag set to 10%. The flag was disabled at 12:50 UTC after approval, leading to a rapid recovery with error rates returning to normal levels. Frontend and checkout services showed some latency but were not the primary cause. The incident is resolved.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Errors Resolved
external.body: Between 12:30 and 12:50 UTC, some customers experienced errors when using the cart service, resulting in difficulties adding items to their carts. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: A high error rate in the cart service was caused by an error injection flag set to 10%, leading to elevated latency and connection errors. Disabling the flag resolved the issue.
output.impact: Customers experienced errors and delays when adding items to their carts for approximately 20 minutes.
output.root_cause: An error injection flag ('cartFailure') was enabled at 10%, causing Valkey connection errors and elevated error rates in the cart service.
output.resolution: The error injection flag was disabled after approval, resulting in immediate recovery of the cart service error rates and latency.

lessons.lesson: Ensure error injection flags are carefully monitored and have automated rollback mechanisms to prevent prolonged service impact.
lessons.applies_when: When an error injection flag is enabled and causes a significant increase in error rates in the cart service.

lessons.lesson: Monitor latency metrics in dependent services like frontend and checkout to quickly identify secondary impacts during incidents.
lessons.applies_when: When cart service errors cause elevated latency in frontend or checkout services.

action_items: Implement automated rollback for error injection flags in the cart service.
Enhance monitoring dashboards to correlate error injection flags with error rates and latency across dependent services.
Conduct a review of flag management procedures to prevent accidental prolonged enabling.
